Hi Alice,

Thanks for flagging this — we understand the urgency. Short answer: Bridgestream is a planned transit partner for a subset of telemetry/observability hops. We don’t expect customer data to move outside the US for FinBank, but there are a few important details and a proposed contingency we want to run by you.

Planned next steps (high level):
- Attached: Draft subprocessor roster v3 (CSV) showing which modules reference Bridgestream.
- We will confirm exact egress IP ranges and ASN within 24 hours.
- KMS: For FinBank we will keep customer-managed CMKs in the Redwood Dedicated region; Bridgestream will not hold plaintext keys.
- Evidence: Bridgestream SOC2 summary + our attestation will be shared; full evidence (bridge vendor certs) available in 5 business days.

Contingency (onshore fallback):
If you prefer to avoid any third-party transit changes during your FedOps window, we can enable an onshore fallback routing policy for FinBank that pins traffic to our existing on-prem/onshore transit path for an initial 90-day window while we complete the vendor questionnaire and evidence review. This will have a minor cost delta (~3-5% on telemetry egress costs) but ensures no change in data residency.

Can you confirm whether FinBank would like us to enable the onshore fallback while your FedOps completes review? If yes, we’ll send the formal plan, timeline, and the evidence bundle (PDF) tomorrow.
